scenarios.name: low_soc_below_threshold
scenarios.description: A battery below the charge threshold raises the one critical alarm.

scenarios.name: low_soc_at_threshold_is_not_breached
scenarios.description: The comparison is strictly less than, so exactly at the threshold is fine.

scenarios.name: low_soc_rounds_to_whole_percent
scenarios.description: The charge is shown without decimals, rounding half away from zero.

scenarios.name: stale_telemetry_names_the_device
scenarios.description: A device that stopped reporting is stale, and the message names it.

scenarios.name: environment_high_needs_fresh_sensor
scenarios.description: An over-limit reading raises an alarm while the sensor is still reporting.

scenarios.name: environment_is_silent_while_the_sensor_is_stale
scenarios.description: An old reading that crosses a limit describes a condition that already ended, so environment alarms wait for fresh data.

scenarios.name: stale_sensor_still_alarms_alongside_a_silent_environment
scenarios.description: The freshness gate suppresses only the environment rules. A sensor that has stopped reporting is itself the alarm.

expected.message: No fresh data from Environment sensor

scenarios.name: tds_lower_limit_without_an_upper_bound
scenarios.description: Nutrient solution runs well past any sane upper cap, so only a minimum is configured and only a low reading alarms.

scenarios.name: environment_group_can_run_without_energy_alerts
scenarios.description: The two toggles are independent, so environment limits still work with energy alerts switched off. 84.25 is exactly representable in binary, so it also pins that both sides round a half away from zero.

scenarios.name: no_rules_when_both_toggles_are_off
scenarios.description: With nothing armed there is nothing to evaluate, background included.

scenarios.name: blank_limit_is_not_monitored
scenarios.description: A limit left empty in Settings means the condition is not watched.

scenarios.name: dead_sensor_raises_offline_not_only_stale
scenarios.description: A device silent past the offline window is a critical alarm in its own right, on top of the stale warning, because "behind" and "stopped" need different responses.

expected.message: No fresh data from Environment sensor

scenarios.name: device_silent_but_within_both_windows_is_only_stale
scenarios.description: The same gap does not escalate until the longer window is crossed, so a brief hiccup never becomes a critical alarm.

scenarios.name: device_that_never_reported_is_not_an_alarm
scenarios.description: Silence from a device that was never read is missing data, not stale telemetry, and must not raise an alarm.

scenarios.name: stale_fish_names_the_tank
scenarios.description: The fish device going quiet is a warning, and the message has to name the tank rather than a device id. This is the only place the fish label is pinned across both languages.

expected.message: No fresh data from Fish tank

scenarios.name: fish_silent_past_the_offline_window_is_critical
scenarios.description: An hour of silence is a stopped sensor rather than a hiccup, so the offline rule joins the stale one instead of replacing it. Both stay armed, which means one long outage produces two notifications — a warning at ten minutes and a critical at sixty. That is the existing behaviour for every device, not something the fish device adds.

expected.message: No fresh data from Fish tank

scenarios.name: fish_normal_reading_is_not_an_alarm
scenarios.description: A fish tank reading within every configured limit stays silent, so the thresholds do not fire on healthy values.

scenarios.name: fish_ph_high_breaches_the_upper_limit
scenarios.description: A pH above the configured maximum raises a warning naming the value and the limit.

scenarios.name: fish_ph_low_breaches_the_lower_limit
scenarios.description: A pH below the configured minimum raises a warning.

scenarios.name: fish_water_temp_high_breaches_the_upper_limit
scenarios.description: A water temperature above the configured maximum raises a warning.

scenarios.name: fish_turbidity_high_breaches_the_upper_limit
scenarios.description: Turbidity above the configured maximum raises a warning.

scenarios.name: fish_alerts_disabled_produces_no_value_alarms
scenarios.description: With fish alerts switched off, even a wildly out-of-range reading stays silent. Stale and offline rules are energy alerts and still fire.

scenarios.name: fish_value_alarm_silenced_while_fish_is_stale
scenarios.description: A stale fish reading that crosses a limit describes a condition that has already ended, so the value rule waits for fresh data. The stale rule still fires.

expected.message: No fresh data from Fish tank
